clue.text: Payments of damages?

definitions.meaning: sums paid regularly to a landlord for the use of a property
as a verb, tears or rips, as in damaging cloth

explanation.definitionFit: Tenants hand over such money each month, and tears in fabric are also called by this word, which as a verb means damages.

clue.text: Screenplay many tear up, in away

indicators.note: the pieces for 'many' and 'tear up' sit inside the letters for 'a way'

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, i.e. many
to tear up a document is to rip it

explanation.surface: Lots of people shred a film script in some fashion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' belongs with 'tear' (to tear up is to rip), not a reversal; 'in' is the container signal round the many-and-tear pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A screenplay is the written text of a film, which is a kind of written text for actors.

clue.text: In second part of race, sprint carelessly

parts.note: a lap is one circuit of a track, a section of a race
a dash is a short fast run

explanation.surface: An athlete sprints wildly during the second lap of a race.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in a hasty, sloppy way is doing it without care.

clue.text: Big egg-producer from nothing, is on the way to be wealthy

parts.note: O looks like the figure zero, nothing
ST is short for street, a way
rich means wealthy

explanation.surface: Someone rising from nothing is on the road to riches.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is on the way to be' reads as one phrase, but 'is on' and 'to be' are links; 'the way' alone gives ST.
explanation.definitionFit: This large flightless African bird lays the biggest eggs of any living species.

clue.text: Later exchanges in court battle

indicators.note: the shuffled letters go inside the word for 'court'

parts.note: to court someone is to woo them

indicators.note: the letters of 'Later' swap places with one another

explanation.surface: Later on, legal exchanges take place in a courtroom fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exchanges' is the anagram signal and 'in' the container. 'court' looks legal, but here it is the verb for wooing someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Napoleon was finally defeated in 1815 at this Belgian village, now a byword for a decisive defeat.

clue.text: Estimate of literary worth?

parts.note: a price estimate given by a tradesman, and also a passage of writing thought worth repeating

explanation.definitionFit: A builder's written price is this word, and so is a famous line lifted from a book.

clue.text: Cruel crime involved minor

indicators.note: the letters of 'crime' are tangled up together

parts.note: less means smaller or minor

explanation.surface: A heartless criminal was caught up in a petty offence.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' is the anagram signal, applied to 'crime' only; 'minor' then follows as a synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Showing no pity is the mark of a cruel person.

clue.text: Churned up mud at the starting line

indicators.note: ground that is churned up is stirred around, so the letters of 'mud at' are mixed

explanation.surface: Muddy ground has been stirred up at the start of a race.
explanation.definitionFit: A datum line is a fixed reference baseline from which measurements start.

clue.text: Make progress by crawling, perhaps

parts.note: the crawl is a stroke used to move through water, not on hands and knees

explanation.definitionFit: Front crawl is a stroke used to move through water in a pool.

clue.text: One taking coat off-and the rest!

definitions.text: One taking coat off-and the rest!

parts.words: One taking coat off-and the rest!
parts.note: a solvent that removes paint, or a performer removing every garment

explanation.definitionFit: Paint remover takes off a coat of paint, while a burlesque artiste removes clothes one by one.

clue.text: Sad reminder from the war

indicators.note: the letters are made from those of 'the war', rearranged

explanation.surface: A painful memory left over from wartime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' signals that the answer is made out of the letters of THE WAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Floral rings are laid at memorials and funerals as tokens of mourning.

clue.text: Visitors to Sicily should see it before coming back

definitions.text: Visitors to Sicily should see it

indicators.note: the Latin word for 'before' returns, read from its end

parts.note: ante is Latin for before, as in ante-room

explanation.surface: Tourists in Sicily ought to visit it before they head home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming back' sounds like the tourists returning home, but it turns ANTE round.
explanation.definitionFit: The island's famous active volcano is a major sight for tourists.

clue.text: About fifty vie to be perfect

indicators.note: the word for 'vie' goes round the letter for fifty

parts.note: to vie is to compete
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Around fifty rivals strive to be flawless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'About' looks like 'roughly', but it is the container: COMPETE goes round L.
explanation.definitionFit: Something whole and lacking nothing is perfect in the sense of total.

clue.text: On board the First Lieutenant may be most important

definitions.meaning: on a warship the second-in-command is known by this nickname

explanation.definitionFit: The Royal Navy calls a ship's executive officer by this title, and the phrase also means the top priority.

clue.text: Modern type of rock has peculiar fans

parts.note: punk is a style of rock music from the 1970s

indicators.note: peculiar means odd, so the letters of 'has' are jumbled

explanation.surface: A new kind of rock music has strange followers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fans' suggests devotees of punk, but means cooling devices; 'peculiar' turns HAS into AHS.
explanation.definitionFit: In India, a punkah is a large swinging cloth cooling device hung from the ceiling.

clue.text: Achieve a win in ten seconds flat

definitions.text: Achieve a win in ten seconds flat

parts.words: Achieve a win in ten seconds flat
parts.note: a boxer floored for a count of ten loses; 'flat' means on the canvas, not just quickly

explanation.definitionFit: A boxing bout ends this way when a fighter stays down for a count of ten.

clue.text: It is pressed into use when distribution by air is required

definitions.text: It is pressed into use when distribution by air is required

parts.words: It is pressed into use when distribution by air is required
parts.note: a spray can works when its nozzle is pressed, sending its contents out as a mist

explanation.definitionFit: A pressurised spray can releases a fine mist when its button is pushed.

clue.text: The way in which one may charm

definitions.meaning: a doorway or gate into a place
to delight or bewitch, a verb

explanation.definitionFit: A doorway is one sense; to put someone in a trance or enchant them is the other, stressed differently.

clue.text: The case resulted in property passing to the State

indicators.note: the letters of 'The case' produce a new word

explanation.surface: A court action ended with an estate going to the government.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resulted in' signals that the answer comes out of the letters of THE CASE.
explanation.definitionFit: In law, land reverting to the Crown or government when an owner dies without heirs is so called.

clue.text: Pardons a sailor's turbulent loves

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor; with the 's it gives ABS

indicators.note: turbulent means disturbed, so the letters of 'loves' are stirred up

explanation.surface: A seaman's stormy romances are forgiven.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a' is only a link; the possessive on 'sailor's' supplies a real letter, and 'turbulent' signals the anagram of 'loves'.
explanation.definitionFit: To forgive someone formally, as a priest does a sin, is to free them from guilt.

clue.text: In truth she goes to the city

indicators.note: the girl's name joined to the word for 'the city' makes the word for truth, so take that word away

parts.note: veracity means truthfulness
taken as written, the word city

explanation.surface: In fact, a woman is heading into town.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'In truth, she goes to the city': a woman's name plus CITY spells VERACITY, truth. 'goes to' joins them, so removing CITY leaves the name.
explanation.definitionFit: Vera is a woman's name, and the clue's pronoun stands for a woman.

clue.text: Swell to fortissimo

parts.note: ff is the musical marking for fortissimo, very loud

explanation.surface: Music rising to a crescendo at full volume.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Swell' looks like a musical crescendo, but it is the noun for a smart dandy.
explanation.definitionFit: A swell is an old word for a fashionable upper-class gent, as is this slang term.

clue.text: Play-but cheat!

definitions.meaning: a violin, or to play one

explanation.definitionFit: A violin is informally called this, and the same word means a swindle or to cook the books.

clue.text: Sense of anxiety possibly nags the third mate

indicators.note: possibly signals another arrangement of the letters of 'nags'
take only the letter in third place of the word 'mate'

explanation.surface: Perhaps worry nags at the third officer on a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'possibly' rearranges NAGS into ANGS; 'the third' takes T, the third letter of 'mate'.
explanation.definitionFit: A German-derived word for deep dread or existential worry.

clue.text: He profits even when told to sell at a loss

definitions.text: He profits even when told to sell at a loss

parts.words: He profits even when told to sell at a loss
parts.note: an agent who trades shares for clients takes commission whether the client gains or loses

explanation.definitionFit: A stockbroker earns commission on every sale a client orders, profitable or not.

clue.text: Setting great store by a spot of publicity

definitions.meaning: taken literally, building up a large stockpile
a large board for posters beside a road

explanation.definitionFit: Stockpiling goods is one sense; a large outdoor advertising board, a billboard, is the other.

clue.text: Directions to prosecute follow

parts.note: E and N are compass directions, east and north
to sue is to take legal action against

explanation.surface: Instructions to take someone to court come next.
explanation.definitionFit: To come after as a result is to follow on.

clue.text: So good nobody will play you?

definitions.text: So good nobody will play you?

parts.words: So good nobody will play you?
parts.note: literally, without anyone to make a game with, because no rival dares

explanation.definitionFit: Peerless or without equal: nobody can be paired against you in a game.
